Item 1A: Risk Factors

Our ongoing investments in artificial intelligence technologies and large language models involve significant research costs and competitive uncertainties.

We generate a substantial portion of our revenues from advertising, and reduced marketing budgets by advertisers could reduce our profitability.

Antitrust and regulatory scrutiny of digital advertising and online platforms could require changes to our search and distribution agreements.

Item 2. Properties

Our principal executive offices are located in Mountain View, California.
